senses.gloss: Vivaha, name of a wind. § 714l (Śukakṛtya): The fifth wind is fraught with great force and speed, and is dry, and uproots and breaks down the trees. It causes calamitous phenomena of many kinds, and produces roaring sounds in the firmament. It is known by the name of V.: XII, 329, 12409.
